subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acmeretail.com>, Leah Turner <leah.turner@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive / next steps

Hi Samir / Leah —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Recap (30 min call): you walked us through the search & personalization use case for Acme stores; primary success metrics are CTR lift on recommendations and a 20% reduction in latency on in-store lookups.
- Internal asks: Leah, we'd love your POV on integration constraints and success criteria at the platform level. Marcus (cc) will own the technical deep dive.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment (30 min) — VP/CTO intro to confirm success metrics and procurement timeline.
2) Technical deep dive (60 min) — Marcus to cover integration architecture, latency/throughput projections, and a demo of a sample workload.

Availability (Pacific):
- Tue 27 Apr, 9:00–9:30am or 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed 28 Apr, 10:00–10:30am

If those don't work, happy to send a Calendly link — reply with preferred times and I'll lock calendar invites.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (summary from today's call).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com | (415) 555-0102
https://redwood.example.com

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive / next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the clear next steps. Leah is out this morning but looping her here (cc). Both of us are interested in the exec alignment call to make sure budget and timeline expectations match our Q3 roadmap.

Of the times you proposed, Tue 27 Apr 3:00pm PT works best for me. Leah, can you confirm? If that slot doesn't work for Leah, we could do Wed 28 Apr 10:00am.

For the technical deep dive: Marcus, would you also be able to cover data residency and our redaction requirements? We need to validate that before we can proceed to procurement.

Regards,
Samir Shah
Head of Product | Acme Retail
samir@acmeretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive / next steps

Samir — thanks, confirmed for Tue 27 Apr at 3:00pm PT pending Leah's confirmation.

Leah — if that works for you I will send the calendar invite now. Proposed 30-minute agenda for the exec call:
- 5m quick intros
- 10m product fit & success metrics (Marissa)
- 10m procurement/timeline Q&A (Samir/Leah)
- 5m next steps and who owns the technical deep dive

Separately, Marcus — noted on data residency & redaction. For the technical deep dive (we're proposing Wed 5 May, 11:00am PT / 60min), can you cover the following?
- Integration architecture and typical network/topology options
- Latency and throughput projections with our 95th percentile targets
- Data handling (redaction, KMS/HSM options, audit logging)
- Demo of 1) streaming responses and 2) prefix caching for repeat queries

If any of those need to move, flag here and I will coordinate.

I'll send the calendar invites + a HubSpot note with the updated timeline (link below).

Calendly link: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-demo?slot=2
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/ACME-2027-001

Thanks — I will send invites once Leah confirms Tue at 3pm PT.

Best,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro + technical deep dive / next steps

Samir / Leah — thanks for including me. Confirming I'll lead the technical deep dive on Wed 5 May at 11:00am PT. Draft technical agenda below — please flag items to add: 

- 5m intros and goals
- 15m architecture & integration options (VPC, Private deployment, API patterns)
- 15m performance (latency SLOs, batching, KV cache behavior)
- 10m security/compliance (data residency, redaction, KMS/HSM, SOC2 evidence)
- 15m demo + Q&A (sample workload, dashboards)

Action items for Acme before the deep dive:
- Share a sample traffic profile (QPS, typical sequence lengths) or an anonymized query log
- Confirm any network egress constraints (VPC peering, IP allowlists)

Attaching a reference architecture diagram: redwood-arch-diagram.png

If you prefer a different date/time for the deep dive, I can be flexible that week.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.example.com
